rationale: Zone 1 set to 80% of protected line impedance (26.39 * 0.80 = 21.11 ohms). Zone 2 covers protected line plus 50% of shortest remote backup BC (26.39 + 0.5*15.77 = 34.27 ohms). Zone 3 covers protected line plus 120% of longest remote backup BD (26.39 + 1.2*18.55 = 48.65 ohms), well below load encroachment limit of 121 ohms. Time delays selected within coordination windows.
